name: week
title: Kitchen weekly review
subtitle: Fictional demo until replaced with your records. Amounts exclude tax.

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select site,kind,item,finding from v_attention order by site,kind

sections.title: Recipe margins
sections.sql: select site,currency,dish,cost_per_portion,sale_price,food_cost_pct,target_pct from v_recipe_costs order by site,dish

sections.title: Par orders
sections.note: Proposals use counted stock plus recorded movements and recipe consumption. Verify stale counts.
sections.sql: select site,item,unit,on_hand,par,packs_to_order,finding from v_par_order order by site,item

sections.title: Usage between counts
sections.sql: select site,item,unit,actual,theoretical,waste,unexplained,basis from v_usage order by site,item

sections.title: Receiving record checks
sections.note: Selected Australian checks only. Findings require an operator review; they are not a food release decision.
